A FOUR-NIGHT FAVOURITE

Srinagar, Pahalgam & a Dal Lake houseboat.

Four nights, five days with two Srinagar nights, one in Pahalgam and one aboard a Dal Lake houseboat.

Your five-day outline

  1. Arrive in SrinagarMeet your representative, transfer to your hotel and see Srinagar’s Mughal gardens.
  2. Gulmarg day tripTravel from Srinagar to Gulmarg and return to Srinagar for the night. Gondola tickets are extra.
  3. Srinagar to PahalgamDrive to Pahalgam, with the Awantipora ruins en route. Overnight in Pahalgam.
  4. Pahalgam to houseboatReturn to Srinagar, board your Dal Lake houseboat and enjoy the included Shikara ride.
  5. DepartureBreakfast, then transfer to Srinagar Airport.

KNOW BEFORE YOU GO

What your package covers.

Package inclusions follow the selected itinerary. Optional activities and some locally operated transfers are paid separately.

Included

  • Accommodation on double sharing
  • Breakfast and dinner
  • Private transport, pickup and drop as per itinerary
  • Toll taxes and service charges
  • Dal Lake Shikara ride

Usually extra

  • Flights, train tickets and meals not listed
  • Gondola tickets, pony rides, guides and entry fees
  • Local union vehicles for certain sightseeing areas
  • Winter chain vehicles when road and snow conditions require them
  • Personal expenses and optional experiences

Winter travel note: Snow and road conditions can change access and transfer arrangements, including in Gulmarg and Sonamarg. Local vehicle, union taxi and activity charges can change; we’ll confirm current arrangements and the final quote for your dates before you book.
